# Weevely

`weevely` &middot; _post-exploitation_

Generates and operates a small PHP webshell for authorised web tests.

**High impact.** This tool can disrupt a target or a network. Confirm scope first.

## What this tool needs

- A web server you are authorised to test.
- Explicit authorisation: this is a backdoor tool.

## How to use it

Creates a PHP agent you upload during an authorised web test to retain access you are permitted to have. Handled here for completeness; never against systems you do not own or have permission to test.

## Examples

```console
$ weevely generate s3cret agent.php
$ weevely https://example.com/agent.php s3cret
```
